blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Patrick Garcia’s decision to revisit his almost two-decade-old controversy with Jennylyn Mercado has sparked strong reactions online, with many netizens criticizing the actor after his tell-all interview with Ogie Diaz on Sept. 30, 2026. Garcia opened up about his relationship with Mercado, her pregnancy with their son, and the circumstances surrounding their eventual separation in 2008. He particularly denied claims that he abandoned his former girlfriend, Mercado, during her pregnancy with their child.
